# Tool-attribution trailers that must not appear in a commit message here.
#
# Only the ATTRIBUTION SHAPE is matched — "Co-Authored-By: <name>" and
# "Generated with/by <name>". A bare product name is never matched and must
# never be: a commit subject like "docs: config examples for Claude Code, Codex
# CLI, OpenCode" is documentation about clients we support, and a check that
# reddened on it would be switched off within a week, deservedly.
#
# ── This file is a deliberate second copy ────────────────────────────────────
#
# The canonical list lives in the fleet tooling repository. A GitHub Actions job
# cannot import a module from another repository — the same constraint that
# forced `.github/hold-labels.txt` to exist, and the same reason this copy can
# drift out of step with it.
#
# Drift is caught by a test, not by this comment. `.github/hold-labels.txt`
# shipped with its own drift on day one — six of nine entries — under a header
# saying the two copies MUST stay identical. A warning does not compare
# anything. The comparison lives in the fleet merge-train self-test, where an
# unreadable file counts as a failure rather than as agreement.
